evals.name: import-timeout-fix
evals.prompt: The product import is timing out on large datasets — fix it using background processing.
evals.expected_output: Replace synchronous loop with Action Scheduler fan-out: dispatcher action queues one as_enqueue_async_action() per item, worker action processes single item and throws on failure for auto-retry. Add progress tracking via option. No exit() or set_time_limit() hacks.

evals.name: recurring-api-sync
evals.prompt: Schedule a recurring job to sync products from an external API every hour.
evals.expected_output: Use as_schedule_recurring_action() with HOUR_IN_SECONDS interval, group name, unique check via as_has_scheduled_action(). Register on plugin activation, clear on deactivation. Worker throws RuntimeException on API failure so AS retries. Log errors via error_log.

evals.name: progress-ui
evals.prompt: Show a progress bar in the admin while the background import is running.
evals.expected_output: Store total/done counts in options. AJAX endpoint checks_ajax_referer, returns my_plugin_get_progress() JSON. Admin JS polls every 2s with setInterval, updates progress bar width and count display, clears interval when complete. No blocking on page load.
